auto.description: Enable Never Ask mode for Kimi sessions

auto_set.description: Whether the user explicitly set --auto, including false

message.description: Initial message to send once the agent is ready

no_wait.description: Return once the process is spawned instead of waiting for the tool's session id

profile.description: Profile whose store holds the session

session.description: Session id, id prefix, title or path

yolo.description: Full auto-approve for Gemini, Codex or Hermes; Kimi: Ask When Needed (middle tier)

yolo_set.description: Whether the user explicitly set --yolo, including false; implied by yolo:true
